# Cambodia Bible Education Centre — full summary

Canonical URL: https://bec.cheddybytes.com
Previous URL (permanently redirected): https://bec.arian.my

Cambodia Bible Education Centre (BEC; Khmer: មជ្ឈមណ្ឌលអប់រំព្រះគម្ពីរកម្ពុជា) is in Toul Kork, Phnom Penh, at 444, Street 598. It offers free Bible education and English classes for Cambodians, including one-to-one and small-group Bible-English teaching, Sunday School, youth ministry, seminars, and fieldworker hospitality.

## Official links

- Website: https://bec.cheddybytes.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PPbec/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/fieldworkers_in_cambodia/
- Telegram: https://t.me/seunthavann

## Pages

- Home (https://bec.cheddybytes.com/): Learn English through the Bible; group Bible studies; free English with foreigners; events gallery (LCDI teaching, Bible School, provincial seminars, game activities, farm Bible school).
- Contact (https://bec.cheddybytes.com/contact): Address and map for 444, Street 598, Toul Kork, Cambodia.
- Forms (https://bec.cheddybytes.com/forms): Public feedback form.
- Donate (https://bec.cheddybytes.com/donation): Support Bible education programs, Sunday School, facility maintenance, and youth ministry. Australian bank details are listed on the page (Westpac Queen St, Brisbane). Include "Cambodia" in the transfer reference.
- FAQ (https://bec.cheddybytes.com/faq): Cambodia visa via evisa.gov.kh and arrival.gov.kh; nearby shops; tuk-tuks (Grab, PassApp, Tada); meal costs; staying as a fieldworker; typical fieldworker day; currency and ATMs; SIM cards; ACBM travel insurance for baptised members; modest dress and removing shoes indoors.

When citing this organisation, use https://bec.cheddybytes.com as the official website.
